title: practice-recovery.share.v2
description: Cleartext Bridge C practice share for the printed recovery sheet. Not sealed under the practice passphrase.

device_fingerprint.description: Mint-time base32(sha256(device_pubkey)); used for display/AAD binding, not from current machine

key_id.description: Hex of 8-byte vendor recovery key id (matches vendor share)

share.description: Base64 of 32-byte random practice_share (also printed as BIP39)

bip39.description: Optional space-separated BIP39 word list encoding the same 32 bytes
